## Context resolved from project knowledge

- **Paper method (arXiv 2606.09498, full LaTeX read):** a fixed LLM agent improves its OWN non-parametric harness (system prompt / tools / runtime rules) with no stronger external model. 3-stage loop: (1) Weakness Mining = cluster FAILED execution traces by a deterministic, verifier-grounded failure *signature* (terminal cause + agent-mechanism), ordered by support; (2) Harness Proposal = the SAME base model generates K diverse-but-minimal candidate edits, each tied to one failure cluster; (3) Proposal Validation = re-run each candidate on held-in AND held-out splits, accept iff it improves ≥1 split and regresses NEITHER. Domain = agentic terminal/coding tasks (Terminal-Bench-2.0) with a deterministic pass/fail verifier. Headline: held-out pass 40.5%→61.9% (MiniMax), +up to 138% relative.
- **No released code** as of 2026-06-15 (no GitHub / HF under the authors). Built on `langchain-ai/deepagents` + Harbor/Terminal-Bench. Adopting = re-implement the loop, not clone a framework.
- **Cost unquantified but eval-heavy** — re-runs the full held-in+held-out eval per candidate per round. Harness is **model-specific by design** (no cross-family transfer tested), so it's a per-model procedure, not a portable artifact — directly relevant to our Qwen-2.5-7B vs GPT-4o-comparison work.
- **EPS already implements ~80% of this loop in spirit:** `workflow-fix-on-bug` protocol → `workflow-improver` agent (= Harness Proposal); `scripts/failure_classifier.py` + `failure_patterns.md` + `epm:failure-lesson v1` markers + `/daily` / `/weekly` / `retrospective` transcript sweeps (= Weakness Mining); `workflow_lint.py` + paired `code-reviewer` + `tests/test_workflow*.py` invariants (= Validation gate).
- **The one genuinely-new rigor the paper adds:** a HELD-OUT, METRIC-GRADED regression gate on harness edits. Today EPS keeps a `workflow-improver` edit on "linter + reviewer judgment + unit tests pass" — there is no quantitative "this edit measurably reduced the failure rate on a held-out set of cases without regressing" check. That promotion gate is the paper's load-bearing contribution.
